replies.author: Plane-Cookie1322
replies.body:
Starfall Defense is a space-themed tower defense strategy game where you build your defenses to hold back waves of enemies.
Pro: The variety of towers and tactical options makes every wave unpredictable.
Con: The high difficulty in the later stages may deter beginners.
Verdict: A solid entry in the genre for fans of thoughtful defense and intense tactical challenges.
